results.title: Tech selloff weighs down Wall St as bond yields climb
results.description: Wall Street's main indices closed lower on Tuesday with semiconductors leading technology declines as Middle East uncertainty pushed bond yields to multiyear peaks, feeding concerns about borrowing costs and inflation.
